g.text: Target Architecture Blueprint: Core Platform, Decoupled Event Pipeline & Pluggable Capabilities
SentinelX Unified Frontend (React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS)
Detection Framework, Alert Triage & Multi-Alert Correlation
Pluggable Capabilities & Response Dispatcher (Major Evolution Hook)
Data Access Layer (Repository Pattern / Unit of Work)
Strict Session Boundary: No Raw Cross-Module Queries • Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM Mappings
Primary Enterprise Store: High Throughput, ACID Transactions
Zero-Dependency Fallback: Instant Offline Testing & Module Isolation
